title: Help Wanted
author: Steve Zakon-Anderson
problems: Row 1 "balance & box circulate - robins cross while larks loop right · balance": two dancers come within 0.44 m of each other.
choices: A gyre goes by the right shoulder, facing each other, with no hands.
Long waves form during the balance before each box circulate: crossers face in, loopers face out; hands join only where they reach.
